text: ふたごじまに　リゾートに　きてるの　わたし

structure.jp: リゾートに　きてるの
structure.en: I've come for a resort holiday

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.span: リゾートに　きてる
patterns.explanation: に before a verb of coming or going can show what you came for. The first に in the sentence is just the place. リゾートに　きてる = 'I'm here for a resort holiday'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: きてる is the shortened spoken form of きている. With 'come' it means you came and are still here. きてる = 'have come and am here'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a statement, a soft form of のだ common in women's speech, gives it an explaining tone. きてるの = 'I'm here, you see'.
